==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Elven Robin Hood stole the Reality Warping Stone from me. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Elven Robin Hood resembles a pale skin male elf with long yellow hair, green eyes, tall pointed elven ears, wearing a green tunic, a brown bow and a leather brown quiver strapped to their back, a green bycocket hat with a red feather, and brown boots. He was riding a brown horse.) (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)
Using my Lucid Light, I turned his horse to stone and bound him with starlight ropes to reclaim the stone. (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
He claimed he wanted to steal it so that the elves had the power to be their own gods.
